axis.source: fitted to OHM's Wilhelmstraße standing in 1917 (1856 of 2069 points every metre within 2.5 m: the straight part from Unter den Linden to the bend before Belle-Alliance-Platz), pointing north; stations in metres north of the Unter den Linden crossing, so negative going south. The bend into the Platz is the axis' bend (frontage.ts), added 11-17 for houses 1-5 and 142-148

bend.source: the street curves east into Belle-Alliance-Platz from about -1890: a circular arc fitted to OHM's 1917 Wilhelmstraße (390672,5817886; 390692,5817837; 390714,5817807) and the middle of the lettering STRASSE on the Straube plan (390697,5817822; 390730,5817790); those five points lie within 4.5 m of it, and the plan's house numbers on the bend 13-20 m out on their own sides (11-17)

first_side: numbers 1-69a go north up the east side from Belle-Alliance-Platz to Unter den Linden; 69b-148 come back south down the west side (the directory's postal line: 1-42a u. 98-148 SW 48, 42b-61 u. 79-97 W 66, 61a-78 W 8). The Auswärtiges Amt (75-76) and the Reichskanzlei (77) are on the west side between the Linden and Voßstraße
corners_source: each corner is the opening in the 1917 fronts (frontage.ts) at the cross street, matched in the directory's order: Behrenstraße -150, Voßstraße -581, Leipziger Straße -750 (OHM's 1917 Leipziger Straße stops 400 m east; the openings face each other on both sides), Wilhelmplatz (the east side's 174 m opening, -664 to -490), Buchhändlerhof -925 (a court with no opening in the fronts and no source for its place: put at the share of house numbers before it, 8 of 19, ASSUMED), Zimmerstraße and Prinz-Albrecht-Straße -1050, Kochstraße -1166, Anhalter Straße -1290, Puttkamerstraße -1419, Hedemannstraße -1577 (OHM) on the west side; the Verlängerte Hedemannstraße at -1556 on the east: the 1910 plan shows no opening there (lots 17-22 run on), so it goes where the directory lists it, between 19 and 20, midway between the plan's 19 (-1571) and 21 (-1526) (ASSUMED; OHM's line meets at -1571, on 19's printed number). Belle-Alliance-Platz at -2035, where the bent axis reaches the Platz's ring of fronts (about 95 m from the Friedenssäule)

known.source: Straube, Übersichtsplan von Berlin (1910), the cache tiles along the street (cache/berlin/rasters/straube): the number printed on the lot, read by eye at 0.25 m a pixel on a 10 m grid (tools/map/stcrop.ts; about 2 m). Every reading sits 8-22 m off the axis on its own side and in walking order (research/straube-numbers-wilhelmstrasse.tsv). A house the directory lists over two numbers is put midway between the plan's two; the tiles sit within 1 m of ALKIS (align_straube_alkis.json), not applied
